109:1.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to these Mushrikûn and Kâfirûn)
(disbelievers in Allâh, in His Oneness, in His Angels, in His Books, in His Messengers, in the Day of Resurrection, and in Al-Qadar)

109:2.text: "I worship not that which you worship,

109:3.text: "Nor will you worship that which I worship.

109:4.text: "And I shall not worship that which you are worshipping.

109:5.text: "Nor will you worship that which I worship.

109:6.text: "To you be your religion, and to me my religion

110:1.text: When there comes the Help of Allâh
(to you, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم against your enemies)

110:2.text: And you see that the people enter Allah’s religion

110:3.text: So glorify the Praises of your Lord, and ask His Forgiveness. Verily, He is the One Who accepts the repentance and Who forgives.

111:1.text: Perish the two hands of Abû Lahab

111:2.text: His wealth and his children will not benefit him!

111:3.text: He will be burnt in a Fire of blazing flames!

111:4.text: And his wife, too, who carries wood
(thorns of Sa‘dân which she used to put on the way of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, or use to slander him)

111:5.text: In her neck is a twisted rope of Masad
